 Versus
State of Uttarakhand & another .......Respondents
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Mr. R.P. Nautiyal, Senior Advocate assisted by Ms. Varsha Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.

2. Ms. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder, present for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent Nos.1 to 3.
3.

A complaint was moved by respondent no. 3 before the learned Magistrate, which has been registered as Complaint Case No. 1602 of 2008 under Sections 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, in which the learned Magistrate has taken the cognizance and issued summons to the applicant.
Hence the present application has been filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Court.

4. Learned Senior Counsel for the applicant submits that this is a case of mistaken identity as the applicant is not "Vijay Kumar" as alleged but he is "Vijay Shankar".
5.

However, considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, no interference is being called for by this Court in the matter at this stage.
6.
Let the applicant appear before the court concerned and move an application for his bail, which shall be considered, as far as possible on the same day itself on its merit in accordance with law.
7. Consequently, the application filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., stands disposed.

(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 07.12.2017 Nitesh Vijay Shankar vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 7 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11581906/
